key: adobe|senior product manager customer journey engagement platform
title: Sr. Product Manager, Customer Journey & Engagement Platform
hiring_location: New York, Remote New Jersey, McLean, Remote North Carolina, Remote Massachusetts
jd_excerpt:
We are looking for: 
A Sr. Manager of Product Management to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our end-to-end Customer Engagement Platform (CEP). You will connect Sales to post-sales, with value realization as the guiding outcome. You will lead a team that serves as the strategic liaison between the customer journey functions and the technical teams that build the platform. Together, you will replace fragmented tools and manual effort with one unified experience.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Own the product strategy and multi-quarter capability roadmap
 Define priority use cases with business leaders. Translate them into signals, workflows, and capabilities from Sales through post-sales
 Lead ongoing discovery with practitioners, leaders, and end users to map personas and workflows
 Turn strategy into prioritized requirements and success criteria. Drive delivery with architects, engineering, data, and systems teams
 Validate delivered capabilities through UAT. Keep a backlog that balances quick wins with long-term priorities
 Infuse AI and automation to surface risk and opportunity, replace manual work, and recommend next best actions
 Align Sales, Customer Success, Product, Operations, Data, and Engineering on priorities, ownership, and outcomes
 Help drive decisions on tradeoffs between speed, scale, and consistency
 Share what is planned, in progress, and next through quarterly planning and executive updates
 Partner with Change & Communications to roll out releases across the organization
 Use post-launch feedback and usage data to improve. Standardize processes across functions
 Coach and grow a team that owns requirements, delivery, and outcomes
 Set consistent standards for requirements, UAT, and roadmap updates
 Qualifications: 
 12+ years in product management, customer success, or business transformation, delivering enterprise-scale products and platforms
 SaaS experience with customer engagement, customer journey, adoption, or customer health
 Deep knowledge of post-sales motions: Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services, and Support
 People management experience leading product, business analysis, or cross-functional teams through complex change
 Hands-on experience with CRM and customer success platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics and Gainsight
 Solid understanding of customer data, telemetry, and analytics
 Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into clear future-state design and prioritized requirements for technical teams
 Experience infusing AI and automation into products and processes
 Strong communication and influence skills, including facilitating senior leaders and large groups without direct authority
 You will have room to grow on a platform that shapes how Adobe delivers value to customers!
 About Adobe 
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
